module: Flowgraph node "AI Debug Display" (category dynamic_p_duration, tags target/trajectory/route/debug). Shows or hides the AI debug visualizations of a vehicle by calling ai.setVehicleDebugMode on the vehicle side. Inputs: vehId (number, 0 or empty = player vehicle) and mode (string: off, target, trajectory, speeds, route; 'off' by default). In 'repeat' dynamic mode the command is resent every frame.

postInit.desc: Provides the list of modes as templates for the mode pin in the editor.

work.desc: If dynamicMode is 'repeat', reapplies the mode every frame.

SetAIDebugMode.desc: Finds the vehicle (vehId or player) and sends it ai.setVehicleDebugMode({debugMode = mode}) via queueLuaCommand.
